pages.title: Step 1: Protocol Core
pages.text: When you first enter the world, you will automatically receive a $(l:arknights_endfield:powering/protocol_core)Protocol Core$() in your backpack. Find an empty 9x9 area (you’ll see a prompt if there isn’t enough space) and place it there.$(br2)The Protocol Core is the heart of the entire industrial system—it generates 200 $(efu) of power per tick and has a built-in 100,000 $(efu) battery. Once placed, it will automatically begin operating.

pages.title: Step 2: Build Power Grid
pages.text: After placing the Protocol Core, you’ll need to use $(l:arknights_endfield:powering/electric_pylon)Electric Pylons$() or $(l:arknights_endfield:powering/Relay Tower)Relay Towers$() to expand the power grid. Place an Electric Pylon within an 80-meter (square) radius of the Protocol Core, and it will automatically connect to the power grid. $(br2) Power-consuming devices (such as manufacturing machines, defense towers, etc.) must be placed within the Electric Pylon’s supply range (a 10-meter square area) to receive power.

pages.title: Step 3: Start Producing
pages.text: Once you have a power supply, you can start placing various production units: $(br)$(li)$(l:arknights_endfield:production1/crafter)Crafter$()—requires no power; manual crafting$(li)$(l:arknights_endfield:resourcing/portable_rig)Portable Originium Rig$()— —No power required; mines ore veins$(li)$(l:arknights_endfield:production1/refining_unit)Refining Unit$()—High-temperature refining of materials $(br2) Place these devices near an Electric Pylon to automatically power them.$(br2) For related recipes, please refer to REI / JEI.

pages.title: Step 4: Build Logistics
pages.text: As your production scale expands, you’ll need $(l:arknights_endfield:logistics/belt) conveyor belts$() to connect the various machines. Conveyor belts automatically pick up items pushed by machines and transport them to their destination. Use $(l:arknights_endfield:logistics/output_port)$() to retrieve items from containers (such as crates), and use $(l:arknights_endfield:logistics/depot_system)$() to send and receive items with the global warehouse system. Pressing the G key ($(br2)) (key binding can be modified) opens the $(l:arknights_endfield:logistics/global_storage)Global Storage$() GUI.
